note: Year-round private RV park on the west edge of Minot off US 2/52, inside a wooded bend of the Souris (Mouse) River with river access; gravel pull-through and back-in sites, many shaded, with a playground. Minutes from the State Fair grounds. Many sites hold monthly and work-crew rigs, but most sites are sold by the night. --Claude
summary: Operator site + Campspot: $50/night FHU plus $2 processing fee, Good Sam 10% off; 118 RV (30/50 A FHU) + 10 tent sites; open year-round (KMOT 2026-06). Price gate passes on the Good Sam exception ($52 -> ~$47). Workforce wording present but ~100 of 118 RV sites sold nightly on Campspot: passes. Google 4.4 (320). Not waterfront stands (channels ~17-25 m wide, behind trees; creekside lead). Count 134 -> 128, max rig 75, season year_round, booking url.
flags: PRICE GATE: '$50 plus processing fee' with 'ALL RATES HAVE $2 PROCESSING FEE' = $52 (mandatory fee counts), over $50; passes on the Good Sam exception: the operator posts 'Good Sam 10% Discount' and the Good Sam directory flags it a Good Sam Park ($50 x 0.9 + $2 = $47). Campspot adds its own booking fee ($3 per stay) instead of the processing fee: $53 per night on Campspot. No gateway needed.

LONG-STAY / WORKFORCE (criteria): the operator's banner reads 'A very clean & reliable RV park for energy and construction workforce, military, and state fair travelers in Minot.'; 'Nightly weekly and monthly rates available.'; 'start living the great life of RV park living'. Nightly share MEASURED on Campspot: the 13 RV site types sold one night at a time showed 88 RV sites available on 2026-10-20 and 100 on 2027-01-26 (of 118), plus the 10 tent sites; i.e. ~75-85% of RV sites are sold nightly. Nothing discourages nightly guests; KMOT (2026-06-17): 'a popular spot for travelers passing through, or those looking to stay a bit longer'. Passes; note says monthly/work rigs are present.
GOOGLE: 4.4 / 320 reviews (Roughrider RV Resort, 500 54th St NW). RV Life stored 4.5 stands.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, not --AWH): stands. The park sits inside a meander of the Souris; the channels measure ~17 m (east channel, 48.24065,-101.36859) and ~24 m (oxbow, south-west) on Esri imagery, under 30 m = creekside class at most. East-row sites in the south lot (48.24065,-101.36887) are ~20 m from the east channel but behind a continuous tree belt. CREEKSIDE LEAD (not upgraded, no site numbers): the two west sites of the south lot (48.24054,-101.36983 and 48.24049,-101.36982) are ~25-35 m from the oxbow's water edge (48.24034,-101.37009) over grass with scattered trees; site numbers would need the Campspot site map.
PIN: stored 48.2415,-101.3705 is in the middle of the site loops (Campspot point 48.24138,-101.37099 ~40 m; Google 48.24101,-101.37180 ~100 m at the entrance). No move.
